name: Kering (Gucci)
verdict: OWNABLE-small (re-court 2026-07-29 w/ H1 actuals, post-miss-autopsy). Fair-ish with positive skew, NOT cheap: spot ~7% below base. The +16% day = mostly a balance-sheet mark (net debt 8.0->3.3bn EUR; Beaute EUR4.0bn closed 3/31 + RE EUR497M + FCF EUR1.8bn) + a stabilization multiple - NOT an earnings inflection (group ROI FLAT YoY at EUR921M; Gucci ROI -4%, margin +1pt on -9% revenue = cost-led; Jewelry +106% ROI and Eyewear are the real engines but small). Gucci still shrinking (Q2 comp -2%, +7pts seq; Demna = one month of US reads). 2H comps flatter MECHANICALLY off the collapsed 2025 base.
fv_note: bear: EBIT ~1.9bn @13x - 3.3bn ND; base: 16.5x x 2.6bn normalized - 3.3bn ND - ~1bn Valentino-put PV (=~38.1bn/122.9M sh; the 2.6bn requires Gucci ~1.4-1.5bn = partial recovery, MORE credible on de Meo but not yet evidenced); bull: 3.2bn @18x on a genuine 2027 inflection. OLD 272 base was STALE: carried 9.5bn net debt after the balance sheet had transformed - ~EUR50/sh of the 'miss' was bookkeeping.
